error.message:
probes: passed → 通过（通过）
Passed for dictation-style appends, one session-end cycle per field, both contexts (efs16d, spec of 17:12 JST): per field (Hospital Encounter, Important Points, pre-round editor; NH visit box, NH pre-round) the session ended on the server, the tail was appended, the sign-in prompt showed ('…code sent to your email'), a new code was entered, and every field held its first line + its own tail, no tail in another field. Hospital passed on its retry (first attempt: Encounter box not found within 20 s on the loaded stack); NH passed first time. NOT exercised: one session end across all fields (the scenario's 'when'); on main the app shows sign-in at the next server call (a tab switch is enough), so a physician cannot reach a second field after the session ends. The patch's oracleNote recording this scope change is PROPOSED for Quinn / Daniela's approval, not merged. History (tails typed key by key until 17:12 JST): efs16 4 attempts timed out on the loaded stack; efs16b + efs16c 7 attempts: 1 passed, 3 with tails missing after sign-in (NH visit x2, Hospital all three x1), 3 timeouts. Key-by-key typing is not a valid driver here: the app switches to sign-in at the first refused autosave and the remaining keys go to the sign-in screen, so only the text that was in the field at the switch exists to restore (a test artifact, not a loss).

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S16 「两个模式下，在每个自动保存的输入框里口述到一半时会话结束：出现登录提示，登录后每段尾巴都回到它自己的输入框里」 Session ends mid-dictation in every autosave field, both contexts: sign-in prompt, and every tail is back in its own field after signing in

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10a Session expired mid-dictation: the dictation is kept, a sign-in prompt shows, and the dictation is available after signing back in.（UAT EFS state 10；TFA-94745 state 10）
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state.（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 3）
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection).（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 5）
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android.（UAT EFS Expected Result；UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Standard fixture; the harness ends the session on the server (sessions:_backdateForTests expiresAt = now − 1 s), never through the device clock

When Type a first line into each autosave field and let it save: Hospital Encounter box, Important Points and the pre-round notes editor; Nursing Home visit box and pre-round. The harness ends the session; type a tail into each field, ending with the Hospital pre-round editor left open; wait 3 s; …

Then A sign-in prompt shows; after signing in each field holds its first line and its own tail, and no tail appears in a different field

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U10a/U13: h1/n1 mustContain 'code sent to your email' (the sign-in prompt); every after-sign-in checkpoint mustContain its field's first line and tail. That each tail sits in its own field and in no other needs a field-value check in oracle.mjs (runnerGap); substring checks alone only prove the tail is on that screen. …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S16

Session ends mid-dictation in every autosave field, both contexts: sign-in prompt, and every tail is back in its own field after signing in

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Scripted probe per context: type first lines in every autosave field (Hospital Encounter, Important Points draft, pre-round editor; NH visit box, NH pre-round), end the session on the server (sessions:_backdateForTests expiresAt=now-1s), type each tail (pre-round editor left open), dispatch visibilitychange, expect the sign-in prompt, sign in with a runner-issued code, read each field's value: own first line + own tail, no other tail. [Review 2026-10-14] Scope is dictation-style appends (each tail added in one input event), one session-end cycle per field: on main the app shows sign-in at the next server call, so one session end across every field cannot be reached by a physician. The oracleNote that records this scope change is proposed for Quinn / Daniela's approval, not merged silently. Key-by-key typing is not used: the remaining keys go to the sign-in screen after the switch (a test artifact). — session-control and browser-events are plain Playwright + the existing roundai.test-only session hook.

Hospital passed on its retry (first attempt: Encounter box not found within 20 s on the loaded stack); NH passed first time. NOT exercised: one session end across all fields (the scenario's 'when'); on main the app shows sign-in at the next server call (a tab switch is enough), so a physician cannot reach a second field after the session ends. The patch's oracleNote recording this scope change is PROPOSED for Quinn / Daniela's approval, not merged. History (tails typed key by key until 17:12 JST): efs16 4 attempts timed out on the loaded stack; efs16b + efs16c 7 attempts: 1 passed, 3 with tails missing after sign-in (NH visit x2, Hospital all three x1), 3 timeouts. Key-by-key typing is not a valid driver here: the app switches to sign-in at the first refused autosave and the remaining keys go to the sign-in screen, so only the text that was in the field at the switch exists to restore (a test artifact, not a loss).

范围（scope）：dictation-style appends (each tail added in one input event), one session-end cycle per field
